# #19 Downloads — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS** (no blocker/major defects). Worktree `md-review-cap-controls` (lane/controls, #18 also present). No diff or `src/` read.
Drivers: `.verify/qa/19/qa.mjs`, `qa2.mjs`, `qa3.mjs`, each run via `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node …` (prod stack). Logs `.verify/qa/19/run.log`, `run2.log`. Exported files are in `.verify/qa/19/files/`, screenshots in `.verify/qa/19/*.png`.

## AC verdicts
- 19.1 PASS: a protected doc opened without a token shows the reader variant, no edit toggle, and the items md/html/pdf. Both downloads work.
- 19.2 PASS (covered by the 5 MB byte-equality check and the unsaved-edit checks; UTF-8 kept, no BOM).
- 19.3 PASS: `notes`→notes.md, `a.txt`→a.md, `x/y:z.md`→x-y-z.md, blank→document.md.
- 19.4 PASS on desktop and phone: `report.htm` (CRLF, `<script>`) shows only `download-html-source`, the bytes are identical, there is no `__mdreview`, and 0 backend requests are made.
- 19.5 PASS: every export has 0 `<script`, 0 stylesheet `<link`, 0 `@import` and 0 `on*=`. Each mermaid diagram is an `<svg>`. Any `class="mermaid"` element remaining wraps an SVG, never raw source.
- 19.6 PASS: github-dark export, opened offline, has a body background of rgb(13,17,23).
- 19.7 PASS: in all 6 themes the export's computed pane background and colour, h1, h2, p, a, pre, hljs, inline code, th, callout, RAG badge and details match the app exactly. The only difference is `body` background, where the app's body is the sidebar/frame colour and the export uses the pane colour, as 19.6 requires. Compare `theme-*-app.png` with `theme-*-export.png`.
- 19.8 PASS: chrome is stripped (copy button, language label, fold toggle/ellipsis, zoom, heading-anchor, reactions; `reaction-bar` appears only in a print-CSS selector). A heading folded on screen exports expanded with 0 `hidden`. The on-screen fold state is unchanged afterwards. `<details>` stays closed.
- 19.9 PASS: the attachment is inlined as `data:image/png`. The external image, the 404 attachment and `data:` URIs are kept.
- 19.10 PASS: in the offline file, the anchor puts the target 12px from the top.
- 19.11 PASS: `print` (stubbed) is called once, after all SVGs exist and the menu has closed. Under print media the folded content and the details body are visible.
- 19.12 PASS: `/d/<id>@<hash>` gives the old revision in both md and html (including its diagram) on desktop and phone, and with `?view=edit`, which falls back to read.
- 19.13 PASS: Enter opens the menu with focus on md. ↓ wraps, Home and End work. Esc returns focus to the button with `aria-expanded=false`. Enter downloads. The button has `aria-haspopup=menu` and `aria-label=Download`.
- 19.14 PASS: at 390×844 there is no `download-menu-btn`. The overflow has a "DOWNLOAD" group with 3 menuitems, each 44px. Downloads work from it and there is no horizontal scroll (`overflow-phone.png`).
- 19.15 PASS: md and pdf make 0 backend requests. The 2 requests I saw were the app's idle polling (`GET /paste/:id`, `/reactions`), and the same 2 appear with no click at all.
- 19.16 PASS: when `createObjectURL` is forced to fail, an error toast says "Download failed", no download happens and the URL is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **Unsaved edits:** in both edit and split views, text typed into the editor and a new diagram appear in md and html. The new diagram is exported as an SVG and the broken one as `<pre><code>`.
- **Mermaid:** syntax errors fall back to `<pre><code>`. With 20 diagrams and none rendered on screen at click time, the export has 20 SVGs and took 168 ms. A diagram never scrolled into view is still exported.
- **Theme switched just before export:** the export uses the new theme, including SVG fills.
- **XSS:** the export adds no scripts and strips the author's `<script>`, `on*` and `onerror`. Opening it offline raised 0 dialogs. The author's `javascript:` link, `<iframe>` and `<style>` are kept, matching the rendered-on-screen rule.
- **Filenames:** emoji are kept. `.env.md` becomes `env.md` (leading dot dropped). A 243-char name becomes 200+`.md` and 200+`.html`. `q?<>|"*` becomes `-`. A tab becomes `-`. `Report.MARKDOWN` is kept.
- **Large docs and repeated clicks:** a 5 MB md download is byte-equal in 75 ms. A double-click on html gives exactly 1 download.

## Defects
1. **minor:** the export ignores the #18 reader settings. At 135% and wide, the app shows p 20.25px/1336px and the export shows 15px/750px. The WYSIWYG goal suggests carrying them over, but neither spec says so; #18 lists print sizing as #19's. This needs a product call.
2. **minor:** tablet overflow download items are 31px tall. AC-19.14 only requires 44px on phone.
3. **cosmetic:** `dot.` becomes `dot..md`. This follows the spec literally.
4. **cosmetic:** task-list checkboxes in the export are enabled and can be clicked.
5. **info:** a relative image (`assets/x.png`) resolves against `/d/` and is kept as an absolute URL, which is broken on screen too.
6. **info:** no busy state was seen on `download-html`, because the exports finished in about 170 ms.
7. **info, outside #19 but worth knowing:** the live app runs author raw-HTML handlers (`onerror` and `onload` raised 3 alerts on screen).
- BLOCKED: the multi-file session case, because #26 has not landed.
